description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Immortal Sun.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Hinterland Sanctifier trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Hinterland Sanctifier trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
